name: pb-cc-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code workflow plugins: discuss (design discussion mode), orchestrate (orchestrator mode for expensive main models), and session-residue (fresh-reader check of deliverables).

plugins.name: discuss
plugins.description: Design discussion mode: /discuss checks the question's frame, keeps a running record of decisions, and holds off file writes (Edit/Write blocked by a bundled PreToolUse hook); /discuss end summarizes outcomes and stops at the junction for the user to choose the next step.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Orchestrator mode for expensive main models: keep planning, verification, and commits in the main session and delegate implementation to the bundled implementer subagent.

plugins.name: session-residue
plugins.description: Keep session residue out of deliverables: a skill with the writing rules, and a residue-check subagent that reads finished files as a reader who was not in the session.
